strategy: Use the highest available Claude tier by agent role. Verify the IDs below against `kiro-cli chat --list-models` before relying on them; Kiro falls back to `chat.defaultModel` when a configured model id is unavailable.

rolePolicy.opus: Highest-reasoning Claude agents: orchestration, planning, and strategic technical advice.
rolePolicy.sonnet: Strong balanced agents: plan execution, plan critique, pre-planning consultation, visual/media interpretation, and bounded delegated execution. `sisyphus-junior` sits here rather than on haiku because upstream v4.19.4 bumped it to a sonnet-class model once junior workers began running real edits plus their own verification; set it back to `claude-haiku-4.5` if cost matters more than upstream parity.
rolePolicy.haiku: Fast economical agents: local exploration and external documentation lookup.
rolePolicy.gpt: Deep single-thread execution. Upstream Oh My OpenAgent restricts Hephaestus to GPT-5.x models and ships a native GPT-5.6 prompt for it; this port follows that. Set it to `claude-opus-5` if you would rather stay on one provider.

fallback: If a mapped model is unavailable in another Kiro account, set that agent to `auto` or the nearest available tier from the same family.
